summary.zh-tw: 登陸後的解放軍與國軍在北山、南山、林厝等村落展開激烈巷戰。雙方對村落戰的戰況描述差異顯著。
summary.en: After landing, PLA and ROC forces engaged in intense house-to-house combat in Beishan, Nanshan, and Lincuo villages. Descriptions of the fighting differ markedly between sources.

roc.zh-tw: 國軍第118師增援後對盤據村落的解放軍發動逐屋清剿。戰車協同步兵推進，以火力壓制後逐棟清除。南山與北山於25日下午至26日上午陸續收復。
roc.en: After reinforcement, the ROC 118th Division conducted house-by-house clearing operations. Tanks provided direct fire support as infantry advanced building by building. Nanshan and Beishan were recaptured between the afternoon of Oct 25 and morning of Oct 26.

pla.zh-tw: 解放軍在村落中構築臨時防禦工事。第253團在北山固守，第251團在南山抵抗。缺乏重武器與補給，但仍擊退國軍多次衝鋒。
pla.en: PLA troops built improvised defensive positions inside the villages. The 253rd Regiment held Beishan and the 251st defended Nanshan. Lacking heavy weapons and supplies, they nevertheless repelled multiple ROC assaults.

civilian.zh-tw: 村裡到處是槍聲。有人躲在地窖，有人逃到田裡。房子被打穿了牆，屋頂塌了。天亮後看到街上到處是倒下的士兵。
civilian.en: Gunfire was everywhere in the village. Some hid in cellars, others fled to the fields. Walls were shot through, roofs collapsed. At dawn, soldiers lay fallen in the streets.

disputes.zh-tw: 國軍：極少數平民誤傷。居民口述：目睹鄰居死於戰火
disputes.en: ROC records: minimal civilian casualties. Resident accounts: witnessed neighbors killed.

disputes.zh-tw: 國軍：局部損毀。實際修復記錄顯示大規模重建
disputes.en: ROC: localized damage. Reconstruction records show large-scale rebuilding was necessary.
